scope: Root reassessment of seven-file clean error delta only, full current bodies and actual patch read; separate independent connected-receiver reviews; no global clearance
head: c8eccb6706c160c21b337c49b401b2f2737513a8

lenses.name: producer propagation
lenses.source_backed_trace: Three view producers construct Observation directly with original request, matching operation and exact scope cause; no intermediary classification helper. Existing generic ComputePass recipients accept the composed Error via standard conversion; independently traced in fresh reports.

lenses.name: existing type owners
lenses.source_backed_trace: TextureFormat and SDK Error/PollError remain authoritative leaves. Observation composes the single shared ValidationScopeError rather than recreating its failure variants.

lenses.name: admission
lenses.source_backed_trace: finish exhaustively maps actual poll/capture outcomes to success, Native, Progress or ProgressWithNative; no missing mandatory cause or fallible string classification. Unit absence states carry no cause.

lenses.name: operations
lenses.source_backed_trace: finish attempts poll then always pops the same-device guard, before classifying all four outcomes. Every observed failure propagates before returning the new view. No arithmetic or new cache mutation added.

lenses.name: aggregate states
lenses.source_backed_trace: ProgressWithNative owns both required causes. Native-only and polling-only variants own exactly their required cause. Removed separate Progress struct with optional native field; no old tag/payload pairing retained.

lenses.name: type ownership
lenses.source_backed_trace: Scope failures live in globals shared scope owner; whole-texture error owns only operation/request context plus canonical scope failure. Exports remove obsolete wrapper. No duplicate owner added.

lenses.name: redundant authority
lenses.source_backed_trace: Operation role and failure kind are independent; one Observation carries each once. Poll and native errors are independently observed evidence, not competing copies of one result. Removed duplicate per-operation native variants.

lenses.name: behavior preservation
lenses.source_backed_trace: Intentional final API and diagnostic changes follow explicit user direction: composed Observation replaces boxed native/progress variants, immediate source becomes scope error, polling failures select poll as primary. No historical API/layout/downcast/message constraints. Required cache admission, descriptor, original request and always-pop semantics remain source-visible.

lenses.name: enum shapes
lenses.source_backed_trace: Texture error has two resource absences and one operation-context observation failure. Scope error has three actual failure products. Successful observation remains Result::Ok, with no extra success tag or optional cause combinations.

lenses.name: derivability
lenses.source_backed_trace: Both TextureViewError and ValidationScopeError derive Debug, Display and Error with explicit source selection. Manual traits, boxed layout, ValidationProgressError, from_observation and unused into_anyhow removed. Locked macro semantics independently read and reviewed.

lenses.name: type granularity
lenses.source_backed_trace: One operation enum expresses 2D/3D/cube roles; no per-operation copy of scope failure model. Three scope failure variants reflect actual distinct payload requirements. No new primitive wrapper without policy.

lenses.name: magic strings
lenses.source_backed_trace: Display attributes are human diagnostics of typed fields. No branching on message text or semantic string selector. Removed old prefix/downcast promises; current documentation describes final shape and sources.

lenses.name: magic numbers
lenses.source_backed_trace: No numeric tuning or gameplay quantity introduced. Existing cube layer count6 is intrinsic descriptor geometry. Error payload leaves are SDK-owned; no new tests/assertions/constants.
